Class MessageService

java.lang.Object
services.BaseService<Chat>
services.GenericService<Chat>
services.MessageService
public class MessageService extends GenericService<Chat>
MessageService is a concrete service. It implements logic for employee chats: sending messages inside a chat, opening a chats between two employees, and removing chats when a participant is deleted.
